name: Fees and budgets
h1: Know who owes what, without the envelope pile.
sub: Assign fees, take payments straight into your program's account, and see every balance the moment it changes.
get: Every student has a live balance that staff, parents and the student can all see. Families pay online through your program's own Stripe, Square or PayPal account, with Venmo through PayPal.
Payments made outside the app, like cash, checks, a direct Venmo payment, Cash App, Zelle or a ticketing site, go to a review queue before they reach a balance.
Every payment gets a receipt. For your boosters, ledgers and fiscal-year budgets track income and expenses, with budget vs. actual as the year goes.
cta: See how your fees would work.

faq.q: Does Program Partner take a percentage?
faq.a: No. Payments go to your program's own processor account. Program Partner charges no payment fees; your processor's standard rates apply.

faq.q: What if a family pays a little more than they owe?
faq.a: The extra is never quietly turned into credit. It waits where you can see it and decide what to do with it.

faq.q: Can our booster treasurer use it without seeing everything else?
faq.a: Yes. Staff and booster roles each get their own permissions.
